summary: Targeting must preserve message-keyed audience attribution through the typed analytics declaration, resolve each distinct message audience once, batch variations with message collections, and avoid profile-count enrichment it does not use.
reason: The 2026-10-15 message-to-audience join already produced results, but converting its []map[string]any through an incompatible slice helper erased matched rows and metrics before validation. Per-message variation reads and an overly conservative message budget added minutes; compound data must be complete before replacing a paginated variation read, and report retries must honor the full Retry-After.
validated_outcome: The full command reproduces the original zero-match rejection before the fix. With 39 message-keyed report rows and 51 audience assignments, two report pages, and one segment/list page each, requests fall from 84 to 45: one batched message lookup, 39 audience reads, and zero variation or profile-count reads. Segment sends/revenue and list/segment exclusions are asserted; duplicate rows do not inflate assignments. Partial compound variations fall back to complete relationship pagination. Message reads retain the published 150/minute ceiling, tag reads retain their lower fallback, reports retain 2/minute, and profile-count pacing remains 15/minute. Real-account verification is recorded separately from fixture evidence.
